{"format":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"verdict":{"enum":["A","B"],"type":"string"}},"required":["verdict"],"type":"object"},"messages":[{"content":"Read the passage below and classify how it is written.

A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
Begin by confirming the deadline applies strictly as of 1 March 2026 for all evaluations. Length must reach exactly twenty-two pages to satisfy R1; anything less fails immediately. Regarding format, either the official template suffices or documented revision history spanning at least three years works, though Track D submissions bypass this requirement entirely by needing exactly two endorsements instead of one. Crucially, Track D exemption applies solely to R2, leaving other constraints intact.

Venue restrictions hinge on precise timing: presentations exceeding eighteen months prior qualify, whereas exactly eighteen months disqualifies a manuscript under R3. Similarly, prior round acceptances block handling if fewer than five years have passed, with the fifth anniversary permitting resubmission. Note that withdrawals reset the venue clock to the withdrawal date for R3 calculations but do not constitute acceptance for R4 purposes.

Paired submissions require precisely two manuscripts; three is impermissible. Both must independently meet length and format rules, yet only one needs to satisfy the venue overlap condition. Figure counts range from eight to forty-five inclusive, extending to seventy for pairs. If figures fall below the minimum without other failures, the verdict becomes PADDED rather than returned. Conversely, exceeding any maximum triggers an immediate RETURN. Finally, open retraction notices override all other provisions, ensuring such manuscripts are never handled regardless of figure adjustments or length compliance.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"llama3.3:70b","options":{"seed":2232038921,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false}
